title: feat(service-messaging): serve the notification topics and channels a preference or template can name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao43VDBgUgyKRgCUkw33nkQN)_

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Refs #30208 (row 6, server half). Ruling E on #30527 (record 6670386759), execution step 1 of comment 6670396132. The card stays open: the ui dropdowns (step 2) follow after this merges, quiet hours (step 3) is its own ui card, and row 5 is not in this PR.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增只读接口 `GET /api/v1/messaging/preference-options`，返回通知偏好与通知模板可选的「主题」和「渠道」清单（`*` 排第一；主题来自平台固定主题、本环境流程通知步骤里写明的主题、本组织已发过的通知主题；渠道列出所有已知渠道，未配置服务的标「未配置」）；三个字段声明下拉控件提示；渠道帮助文字补上 push（十一种语言）。
- 为什么改：管理员在 通知偏好 里只能凭记忆手打主题和渠道的机器名，打错一个字母就静默失效；按 #30527 裁决 E，服务端先给出清单，控制台下一张卡据此画「可选可填」的下拉。
- 风险与回滚：字段仍是文本、`*` 照存、不新增任何拒绝，已存数据不动；新接口只读、仅限已登录成员，且每个组织只看得到自己组织的已存主题。回滚即撤销本 PR，控件提示在控制台注册前本来就退化为文本框。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/preference-options.ts`（三个主题来源与组织边界的 `organization_id` 条件）、`src/preference-options-routes.ts`（拒绝顺序：身份→受限登录→匿名→查询参数）、`src/messaging-service-plugin.ts` 的挂载段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/preference-options-routes.integration.test.ts`，预期 8 个用例全过（含「B 组织的主题不会出现在 A 组织」）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **A read-only list route, mounted by service-messaging itself** (route B in the seat's claim 6688765720): `registerPreferenceOptionsRoutes` (`src/preference-options-routes.ts`) mounts `GET /api/v1/messaging/preference-options` on `http-server` at `kernel:ready`, as service-settings / service-print / service-storage mount theirs. The sibling `/api/v1/notifications` routes live in `packages/runtime` behind `INotificationService` (a spec contract), so a runtime face would have needed a spec card; this PR touches neither `packages/runtime` nor `packages/spec`. A kernel with no HTTP server logs one `warn` naming what is not mounted.
- **Who may ask** (the posture of `/api/v1/notifications`): any signed-in member. The caller is resolved by the one composition (`resolveRequestExecutionContext`, session or API key); an authorization-store outage and an API key lifecycle refusal are relayed as declared; a held sign-in is `403` with the policy's code; anonymous is `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`; the closed query set is empty, so any query parameter is `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming it. All of these answer before any source is read.
- **What it serves** (`src/preference-options.ts`), response `{ success: true, data: { topics, channels } }`:
  - `topics: Array<{ value: string; wildcard: boolean; sources: Array<'platform' | 'flow' | 'stored'> }>`: `{ value: '*', wildcard: true, sources: [] }` first, then sorted and de-duplicated, each with every source naming it: `PLATFORM_NOTIFICATION_TOPICS` (15 fixed topics measured from their send/template sites in plugin-approvals, plugin-audit, plugin-security, plugin-auth); every `notify` step's own string `topic` in this environment's flows (`protocol.getMetaItems({ type: 'flow' })`), and `notify` for a step that names none (the node's own default); the distinct `sys_notification.topic` values of the caller's organization (one `aggregate` grouped by `topic`, `where: { organization_id }`, under a named system context `PREFERENCE_OPTIONS_SYSTEM_CONTEXT`; a caller with no organization gets no stored topic).
  - `channels: Array<{ value: string; wildcard: boolean; configured: boolean }>`: `*` first, then `MessagingService.getKnownChannels()` (new): directly registered channels, then each lazy provider, `configured: false` when its transport is absent ("not configured").
  - A source that cannot be read answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with the door's sentence and the error in the fault log, never a partial list.
- **The fields**: `sys_notification_preference.topic` declares `widget: 'notification-topic'`, `.channel` declares `widget: 'notification-channel'`, `sys_notification_template.topic` declares `widget: 'notification-topic'`. `FieldSchema.widget` is an existing free `z.string()`, so no spec value is added; an unregistered widget degrades to the text box. The template's `channel` keeps `channel_renders_template` and declares nothing.
- **The help**: the preference channel help names `push` (registered as a lazy provider since #29041), in the English source and all ten translated bundles; `en` regenerated by `check-i18n-bundles --write`.
- **Ledger**: `src/messaging-route-ledger.ts` (one `server-only` row) with its package-local conformance test, and the three wiring lines the claim names: the live-mount parity dogfood test imports the ledger, and `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` / `turbo.json` declare it as that test's input.
- **Envelope guard**: `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` declares the new door in `MODULES` at `{ responses: 0, ok: 0, err: 0 }` beside the print door (every body goes through the shared `sendOk` / `sendError` / `sendServerFault`). The claim was widened to this path for it.

## Tests

- `src/preference-options-routes.integration.test.ts` (new, 8 cases), real resolver over a fake auth service, real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3) holding `org_a` and `org_b` on the `isolated` posture: the full list and its sources; cross-organization isolation (a topic stored in `org_b` never listed for `org_a`, and the reverse); no protocol means no flow topic; anonymous `401`, held sign-in `403 PASSWORD_EXPIRED`, query parameter `400` naming it, each asserting by envelope (ApiError parse + code + status) and that no source was read; a failing source `500`, no data.
- `src/messaging-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` (new): registrar enumeration against the ledger, both directions.
- `src/objects/notification-preference-topic-channel-help.test.ts` re-pinned: the built channel ids are `['inbox', 'email', 'sms', 'push']` (push factory added to the enumeration) and the help names exactly those; `push` left the "named but not implemented" list; a new case pins the three widget hints, the template topic's `text` type, and no widget on the template channel.

## Acceptance notes

- **Flows are the environment's, not an organization's** (ADR-0131 D6: the list serves the environment's rows and no organization's), so every organization of one environment is offered the same flow topics; the organization boundary applies to the stored topics, which is what the isolation pin holds.
- **`PLATFORM_NOTIFICATION_TOPICS` is a measured constant**, since nothing registers topics (ADR-0030's `defineTopic()` was never built). A feature that starts sending a new fixed topic must add it there; no gate catches a miss. `auth.phone_otp` / `auth.phone_invite` are template topics (the SMS goes out without `emit()`), listed because the template form reads the same list; on a preference they match nothing.
- The stored-topic read is unbounded in the number of distinct topics (one grouped `aggregate`, no limit in `EngineAggregateOptions`); the event table's 90-day lifecycle window bounds it in practice.
- The anonymous floor test first stayed green under a narrower mutation (`shouldDenyAnonymous` removed, `!context` kept), because the fail-closed composition already answers no context for an unauthenticated request; the second mutation removed the whole branch and went red (below). Both runs are recorded.
- **A derived-gate blind spot**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` did not derive `pnpm check:route-envelope` for this diff's paths, so the 86 local gates were green while CI's `Lint · docs & code guards` went red on `Response-envelope guard` (run 42254020926, `NOT DECLARED`) at `d4930694`. Fixed in `581fce5c`; a new `*-routes.ts` module outside the derivation's reach needs that command run by hand.
- No `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` or ADR edit: no published sentence states these fields have no list. The ui half (registering `field:notification-topic` / `field:notification-channel`) is the next card.

## Verification

All readings on head `d4930694` unless a line says otherwise (`d4930694` = `00bd47c0` + merge of `origin/main`, 8 commits, only `turbo.json` overlapping; head `581fce5c` adds only the envelope-guard declaration).

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, lint (on 00bd47c0, before the main merge)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging typecheck` under the verify lock: Test Files 69 passed (69), Tests 874 passed (874); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-messaging/src packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`: 8/8 passed on the showcase boot, which logged `[messaging] preference options list mounted at GET /api/v1/messaging/preference-options`; VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Negative-pin ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- Organization term deleted (`where: { organization_id: organizationId },`, anchor 1 -> 0): `a topic stored in one organization never appears for another` failed, `AssertionError: expected [ '*', 'approval.comment', …(18) ] to not include 'org_b.secret_topic'`.
- Anonymous branch replaced by `if (false as boolean) {`: `refuses an anonymous caller 401 UNAUTHENTICATED` failed, `expected [ 'INTERNAL_ERROR', 500 ] to deeply equal [ 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 401 ]`. (First mutation, `if (!context) {`, stayed green: see Acceptance notes.)
- Held sign-in gate disabled: `refuses a held sign-in 403 ...` failed.
- Query refusal disabled: `refuses a query parameter 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming it, never ignoring it` failed.
- Notify-type filter disabled (every node read as a notify step): the list case failed on `not.a.notify.topic`.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `00bd47c0` (25 paths): 86 commands, every one run with stdin from /dev/null, all `:: exit 0`.
- `--ran`: `86 derived, 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- After the main merge, on `d4930694`: `pnpm check:turbo-task-graph`, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `pnpm check:ci-filter-parity`, `pnpm check:i18n`: exit 0 each.
- On `581fce5c`: `pnpm check:route-envelope` exit 0 (`--self-test` then the audit; was `NOT DECLARED` for `preference-options-routes.ts` before), `npx eslint --no-inline-config scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` exit 0.
- Changeset: `.changeset/30208-messaging-preference-options.md`, `@objectstack/service-messaging: patch`, carrying both declaration lines at line start.
- Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

</details>
